name: QB Rolling EPA Differential (Basic)
hypothesis: Teams with starting quarterbacks possessing a net positive rolling dropback EPA differential (> +0.12 EPA/play over past 6 starts) outperform standard market point spreads because the betting public overweights raw team win-loss record rather than underlying per-snap efficiency.
entry_rule: Bet spread when absolute differential between opposing QBs 6-game rolling dropback EPA exceeds 0.12.
price_rule: Standard spread odds (-110 or better; minimum model-implied edge >= 2.0%).
exit_rule: Settles at official NFL final score margin against closing spread line.
failure_analysis: v1 suffered in extreme weather games and against elite coverage secondaries that depressed passing EPA regardless of QB skill.
limitations: Does not account for opposing secondary health or weather factors; early-season sample size noise (Weeks 1-3).

name: QB Net EPA Adjusted for Opponent Defense
hypothesis: Refining QB EPA by subtracting opponent passing defense EPA allowed provides a truer signal of passing dominance and avoids false positives against weak schedules.
entry_rule: Bet spread when opponent-adjusted net passing EPA differential exceeds 0.15.
exit_rule: Settles at official NFL final score against spread line.
failure_analysis: v2 improved win rate by 2.4% over v1 but struggled when starting QBs suffered late practice injuries.
limitations: Requires at least 4 games of defensive data in the current season.

name: QB EPA Composite with CPOE & Pressure Filter
hypothesis: Combining 70% opponent-adjusted passing EPA with 30% CPOE filters out lucky high-EPA games driven by broken coverages, yielding highest Sharpe ratio.
entry_rule: Composite passing score differential >= 0.18 and starting QB confirmed in Friday injury report.
exit_rule: Settles at official NFL final score against spread line.
failure_analysis: Losses primarily correlated with extreme turnover variance (≥3 turnover margin).
limitations: Sensitive to backup QB transitions where historical sample is minimal.

name: QB Pressure Response & Sack Avoidance
hypothesis: QBs who maintain EPA under pressure (> -0.05 EPA/play when pressured) and avoid sacks (<6% pressure-to-sack) provide hidden value against blitz-heavy defenses that market overvalues.
data_sources: Next Gen Stats time to throw
entry_rule: Bet spread when QB pressure EPA differential >0.10 and opposing defense blitz rate >30%.
failure_analysis: Fails when OL injuries cause pressure rate to spike beyond historical norms.
limitations: Requires pressure tracking data available only from 2018 onward.

name: QB CPOE & Deep Passing Efficiency
hypothesis: QBs with CPOE > +4% and deep ball completion >42% create explosive play variance that market totals underprice, especially outdoors in low wind.
entry_rule: Bet Over when both QBs CPOE > +2% and wind <10 mph and total <48.
failure_analysis: Red zone turnovers negated explosive plays.
limitations: Early season CPOE noisy with <4 games.

name: Backup QB Market Overreaction Fade (2.5 pt move)
hypothesis: Sportsbooks over-penalize backup QB teams by 3-6 points, creating contrarian value on backup team against inflated number.
entry_rule: Bet spread on downgraded team when opening-to-closing line movement exceeds 2.5 points in opponent's direction.
price_rule: Take spread with underdog buffer at -110 or better.
exit_rule: Settles at official game conclusion against closing spread.
failure_analysis: Failed when backup was raw 3rd-string rookie vs top-5 blitzing defense.
limitations: Cannot distinguish veteran vs 3rd-string in v1.

name: Backup QB Extreme Line Shock (>3.0 pts)
hypothesis: Extreme line moves >=3.0 pts isolate max market panic and achieve +56.2% cover rate.
entry_rule: Bet spread when spread movement >=3.0 points against injured starter's team.
failure_analysis: Low bet volume (~8-12 per season) increases variance.
limitations: Low opportunity frequency.

name: High Wind Outdoor Totals Under (>15 mph)
hypothesis: Outdoor games in sustained winds >=15 mph experience severe passing degradation and missed FGs, systematically finishing Under.
entry_rule: Bet Under on outdoor games with wind >=15.0 mph and total >=38.0.
exit_rule: Settles on final combined score vs total line.
failure_analysis: Suffered when total had already steamed down below 37.0.
limitations: Wind forecast volatility >24h prior.

name: High Wind Filtered Total Floor (>16.5 mph, Total >=40.5)
hypothesis: Filtering to >=16.5 mph and total >=40.5 avoids low-total traps and captures higher variance.
entry_rule: Outdoor non-dome, wind >=16.5 mph, closing total >=40.5.
failure_analysis: Defensive TDs / pick-sixes primary loss drivers.
limitations: Only triggers Nov-Jan and coastal stadiums.

name: Severe Gale & Sub-Freezing Extreme Weather Under
hypothesis: Extreme gale >=18 mph creates insurmountable barrier to vertical passing, hitting Under at 59.4% over 20 seasons.
entry_rule: Wind >=18.0 mph, outdoor, total >=40.5.
failure_analysis: OT sessions pushed totals over.
limitations: Extremely low sample (10-18 games/year).

name: Dome Fast Pace Totals Over (Top-Half Pace)
hypothesis: Indoor stadiums eliminate environmental friction, allowing top-half pace offenses to generate higher play volume and score over conservative totals.
entry_rule: Roof dome/closed, both teams top 14 pace, total <=48.5.
failure_analysis: Red zone stalling (FGs instead of TDs).
limitations: Fails when one offense adopts extreme ball-control run script.

name: Dome High Pass Rate Over Expected (PROE)
hypothesis: Adding PROE >0 ensures both teams actively seek passing efficiency indoors.
entry_rule: Dome, both teams PROE >+1.0%, total <=48.5.
failure_analysis: Defensive red zone stands causing 4+ FGs.
limitations: Sample limited to indoor venues.

name: Home Rest Advantage (>= +3 Days)
hypothesis: Home teams with rest advantage >=3 days cover spread at elevated rate due to recovery and prep.
entry_rule: Bet home spread when home_rest - away_rest >=3 days.
failure_analysis: Market increasingly prices rest differential on Sunday games.
limitations: Rest edge narrowed on standard Sunday-to-Sunday.

name: TNF Short-Week Road Team Fade
hypothesis: Road teams on TNF with only 4 days rest suffer compressed recovery + travel fatigue, covering ATS under 45%.
entry_rule: Bet Home Spread on TNF when away_rest <=4 days.
failure_analysis: Elite QBs with pre-snap audibles can overcome fatigue.
limitations: Only ~16 TNF games per season.

name: Cross-Country Travel & Time Zone Fatigue
hypothesis: West Coast teams traveling east for 1PM ET games with >2000 miles and 3 time zones suffer circadian and recovery disadvantage, historically 44% ATS.
entry_rule: Bet home when away travel >2000 miles and tz_crossed >=3 and gametime is early 1PM ET.
failure_analysis: Elite teams with veteran QBs mitigate travel.
limitations: Requires stadium coordinate mapping.

name: International Game Under (London/Munich/Mexico)
hypothesis: International games go Under due to travel, unfamiliar turf, conservative play, and reduced offensive efficiency.
entry_rule: Bet Under on any game where stadium contains London, Tottenham, Wembley, Munich, Mexico, Frankfurt.
failure_analysis: High-powered offenses still score in London shootouts.
limitations: Only 3-5 international games per year.

name: Calibrated Elo Spread Edge (>= 2.0 pts)
hypothesis: FiveThirtyEight calibrated dynamic Elo exposes market spread biases when model spread differs by >=2.0 points.
entry_rule: Bet spread when absolute difference between Elo projected spread and market spread >=2.0 points.
failure_analysis: Too many bets on small 2.0-pt edges eroded profits via vig.
limitations: Does not adjust for mid-week key injuries.

name: Elo Spread Edge (>= 2.8 pts Threshold)
hypothesis: Raising minimum spread discrepancy to 2.8 points filters noise and beats vig consistently.
entry_rule: Absolute discrepancy >=2.8 points.
failure_analysis: Suffered during rapid QB scheme transitions early season.
limitations: Elo responds with 2-3 week lag to sudden roster changes.

name: Elo High-Discrepancy Kelly Sizer (>= 3.5 pts)
hypothesis: Targeting large structural discrepancies >=3.5 points with quarter-Kelly maximizes compounded growth.
entry_rule: Spread edge >=3.5 points and model prob >=56.5%.
price_rule: Quarter-Kelly stake based on calculated edge.
failure_analysis: Drawdown clusters during high-dog upset weeks.
limitations: Lower bet frequency but highest profit factor.

name: Bivariate Poisson Totals Arbitrage (2.5 pt diff)
hypothesis: Simulating 60x60 joint score probabilities via bivariate Poisson reveals mispriced totals.
entry_rule: Bet Over/Under when Poisson projected total differs from market total by >=2.5 points.
failure_analysis: Underestimated variance on blowout games with late garbage-time scores.
limitations: Assumes score independence between teams.

name: Bivariate Poisson Totals (3.5 pt Filter)
hypothesis: Restricting to >=3.5 point divergence avoids noise and delivers +55.8% win rate.
entry_rule: Poisson projected total divergence >=3.5 points.
failure_analysis: OT scoring converted Under wins to pushes/losses.
limitations: Requires at least 3 weeks of current season scoring data.

name: Logistic Regression Spread Model (5 Features)
hypothesis: Logistic regression using Elo diff, rest diff, wind, injury diff, pressure diff predicts spread cover with calibrated probabilities.
entry_rule: Bet when logistic model prob >55% and edge >=2.5%.
failure_analysis: Overfits to early season small samples.
limitations: Linear model cannot capture non-linear interactions.

name: Gradient Boosting Totals Model
hypothesis: Ensemble of weak learners (wind, temp, pace, Elo total, injury) via gradient boosting predicts totals with non-linear thresholds.
entry_rule: Bet Over/Under when GB projected total differs >=2.0 from market and edge >=3%.
failure_analysis: Sensitive to outlier weather forecasts.
limitations: Requires at least 5 features; early season pace noisy.

name: Bayesian Hierarchical QB Tier Model
hypothesis: Bayesian shrinkage for QB/team strength stabilizes early-season estimates and prevents overreaction to 1-2 game samples.
entry_rule: Bet when Bayesian posterior prob >55% and diff >0.12.
failure_analysis: Prior too strong can underreact to true breakout.
limitations: Prior selection influences early season heavily.

name: 5-Model Ensemble (Elo+Poisson+Logistic+Bayes+MC)
hypothesis: Ensemble of 5 diverse models (Elo, Poisson, Logistic, Bayesian, Monte Carlo) reduces variance and improves calibration via weighted average.
entry_rule: Bet when ensemble prob >56% and all 5 components agree on side direction.
failure_analysis: Ensemble can be conservative, missing some edges.
limitations: Computational heavier; requires all sub-models.

name: Reverse Line Movement Tracker (1.0 pt move)
hypothesis: Following opening-to-closing steam (professional syndicate action) yields positive CLV and long-term ROI.
entry_rule: Bet spread on side receiving steam when line moves by >=1.0 point.
failure_analysis: 1.0 pt moves on dead numbers provided lower equity than moves through key numbers.
limitations: Does not distinguish key numbers (3,7) in v1.

name: Sharp Steam Movement (1.5 pt move)
hypothesis: Requiring 1.5-pt opening-to-closing move filters minor book balancing and isolates syndicate positions.
entry_rule: Spread moves by >=1.5 points from open to close.
failure_analysis: Late injury announcements that caused move sometimes worsened in-game.
limitations: Must capture price before full move occurs.

name: Major Steam Line Mover (>= 2.0 pts)
hypothesis: Line movements >=2.0 points represent strongest institutional conviction, achieving +56.5% cover rate.
entry_rule: Line moves by >=2.0 points in one direction.
failure_analysis: Very few losses outside extreme 4th quarter backdoor covers.
limitations: Lower trade count per season (~20-25 games).

name: Public Betting Fade & Reverse Line Move
hypothesis: When public betting is heavy on one side (>70%) but line moves opposite, sharp money is fading public, creating value.
data_sources: public betting proxy via line movement
entry_rule: Bet opposite of line move when move >=1.0 pt and implied public side is opposite.
failure_analysis: Public data proxy imperfect; actual public % not directly observed.
limitations: Requires actual public betting data for full validation; currently uses line move as proxy.

name: Alternate Spread Value Extractor
hypothesis: When main spread has >=4 pt edge, alternate spreads offer even better risk-adjusted value at plus money.
entry_rule: Bet alt spread when main edge >=4.0 pts and alt odds provide >=5% edge.
failure_analysis: Alt spreads have higher variance and lower hit rate.
limitations: Alt lines not in historical archive; forward test only.

name: Positional Injury WAR Delta (1.5 pt diff)
hypothesis: Aggregating position-specific WAR lost from official Friday injury report pinpoints games where one team suffers net point disadvantage not reflected in spread.
entry_rule: Bet spread on healthier team when net injury point differential exceeds 1.5 points.
failure_analysis: v1 treated all Questionable players equally without inspecting Friday practice status.
limitations: Did not distinguish DNP vs LP in Questionable.

name: Injury WAR with Practice Participation Weights (2.2 pt diff)
hypothesis: Incorporating practice participation (DNP vs LP vs FP) accurately weights inactive risk and uncovers deeper mispricing.
entry_rule: Net injury differential >=2.2 points with practice weighting.
failure_analysis: Backup OL playing better than replacement baseline in short stretches.
limitations: Requires structured Friday injury report data.

name: High-Impact Injury Cluster Advantage (>= 3.0 pts)
hypothesis: Multiple key injuries clustering on one unit (e.g. LT+C OUT, or CB1+CB2 OUT) create cascading failure modes that single-player models underestimate.
entry_rule: Cluster injury advantage >=3.0 points on healthier team.
failure_analysis: Rare blowout upsets where healthier team committed excessive turnovers.
limitations: Cluster injuries happen in ~15% of matchups.

name: Offensive Line Continuity Advantage
hypothesis: Teams with 5 returning OL starters and no OL injuries have +1.2 point advantage vs teams with <=3 continuity due to communication and stunt pickup.
entry_rule: Bet spread when OL continuity advantage >=1.2 pts.
failure_analysis: Elite DL can still dominate even intact OL.
limitations: OL continuity tracking requires weekly depth chart data.

name: OL Continuity + Mismatch Weighted
hypothesis: Combining continuity with pass-blocking vs opposing pass rush mismatch improves signal.
data_sources: OL continuity + PFR pressure + DL mismatch
entry_rule: OL net advantage >=2.0 pts including mismatch.
failure_analysis: Run-heavy game scripts reduce OL pass-blocking impact.
limitations: Requires both OL and DL advanced stats.

name: OL Pressure Mismatch Totals Under
hypothesis: When both teams face high pressure rates (>32%) due to OL vs DL mismatch, sack and TFL rates spike, drives stall, totals go Under.
entry_rule: Bet Under when avg pressure >32% and total >=41.
failure_analysis: Mobile QBs can scramble to extend drives vs pressure.
limitations: Pressure data only from 2018 onward.

name: Defensive Pressure & Sack Rate Mismatch
hypothesis: Teams with top-quartile pressure rate (>35%) and sack rate (>8%) generate negative EPA plays and short fields, covering spread vs weak pass-blocking OL.
entry_rule: Bet spread when defensive pressure advantage >=1.0 pts.
failure_analysis: Quick-release offenses neutralize pressure.
limitations: Pressure tracking begins 2018.

name: Elite Pass Rush vs Vulnerable OL (>1.8 pts)
hypothesis: Requiring >=1.8 pt defensive advantage filters to elite rush vs bottom-10 OL, hitting 55.8% ATS.
entry_rule: Defensive advantage >=1.8 pts.
failure_analysis: Referee holding calls can extend drives vs dominant rush.
limitations: Sample limited to extreme mismatches.

name: Man Coverage Rate Totals Under
hypothesis: High man coverage (>40%) leads to more contested catches and lower YAC, suppressing total points vs market.
entry_rule: Bet Under when avg man coverage >40% and total >=42.
failure_analysis: Elite separators beat man coverage for explosives.
limitations: Coverage tracking limited; requires Next Gen Stats.

name: Red Zone Defensive Efficiency Edge
hypothesis: Teams with top red zone defense (<50% TD allowed) vs bottom red zone offense (<52% TD scored) force FGs, covering spread via hidden points.
entry_rule: Bet spread when red zone efficiency differential >=12%.
failure_analysis: Turnovers inside red zone skew efficiency.
limitations: Red zone sample small early season.

name: Kalshi Spread YES/NO Binary Contract Arbitrage (5c Edge)
hypothesis: Kalshi binary spread contracts trade at retail favorite premiums, creating +5c to +10c discrepancies vs Poisson distributions.
entry_rule: Buy YES/NO when fair price differs from ask by >=5 cents.
price_rule: Limit order at ask + slippage model.
exit_rule: Contract settles at $1.00 if condition met, $0.00 if not, with $0.01 fee.
failure_analysis: Orderbook depth behind touch caused slippage on large sizes.
limitations: Subject to Kalshi orderbook liquidity bounds ($500 max).

name: Kalshi Spread Bracket High-Edge (8c Edge)
hypothesis: Requiring 8-cent edge ensures after 2-cent spread and fees, net ROI exceeds +18%.
entry_rule: Model probability edge >=8.0 cents per contract.
price_rule: Execution at market ask with volume-based slippage.
failure_analysis: Occasional 1-pt push margin on whole-number barriers.
limitations: Fewer qualified contracts per game slate.

name: Kalshi Totals YES/NO Bracket Arbitrage
hypothesis: Kalshi total contracts (Will game go Over X points?) have similar retail bias to spread contracts, especially on high totals.
entry_rule: Buy YES/NO on totals when fair differs >=6 cents from market.
failure_analysis: Weather late changes affect totals more than spreads.
limitations: Totals liquidity thinner than spreads.

name: High-Flag Referee Crew Low-Total Over (>14.5 flags, <=43.5 Total)
hypothesis: High-flag crews (>14.5 penalties/game, high DPI rates) extend drives via automatic first downs, beating low totals.
entry_rule: Bet Over on totals <=43.5 when referee crew avg >=14.5 penalties/game.
failure_analysis: Offensive holding penalties stalling drives in FG range.
limitations: Ref assignments only published 4-5 days before gameday.

name: Public Strategy Replication: Thursday Night Under
hypothesis: Testing public hypothesis that TNF games go Under due to short prep, fatigue, conservative play.
entry_rule: Bet Under on all Thursday regular season games with total >=41.0.
failure_analysis: High-powered divisional offenses break trend.
limitations: Modest edge historically (+53.8%) but high variance.

name: Public Fade & RLM Contrarian (Key Numbers)
hypothesis: Fading public when line moves opposite through key numbers (3,7) captures stronger sharp conviction.
entry_rule: Bet opposite of line move when move >=1.5 pt through key number.
failure_analysis: Public proxy imperfect; key number crossing rare.
limitations: Requires actual public betting % for full validation.

name: Analytical 4th-Down Aggressive Coach ATS Advantage
hypothesis: Head coaches who make mathematically optimal 4th-down decisions (+WP) gain +2.5 to +3.5 pts hidden expected margin that books fail to price vs conservative punters.
entry_rule: Bet spread on coach with >=+20% 4th-down go-for-it rate differential over opposing coach.
failure_analysis: Failed 4th down conversions deep in own territory giving opponents short fields.
limitations: New head coaches have small sample in Weeks 1-4.

name: Coaching Pace & Tempo Tendencies Over
hypothesis: Coaches with top-quartile neutral pace (<30 sec/play) and high early-down pass rate generate more plays and points, beating totals.
entry_rule: Bet Over when both coaches top-10 pace and total <=47.5.
failure_analysis: Run-heavy game scripts vs weak run defenses can still be slow.
limitations: Pace varies by game script; need neutral pace filter.

name: WR Usage & Target Share Prop Over
hypothesis: WRs with >22% target share and >85% route participation exceed receiving yards props vs market that uses recent average not role.
entry_rule: Bet WR1 Over receiving yards when target share >22% and route >85% and opponent allows >7.5 YPA.
exit_rule: Settles on official player stat vs prop line.
failure_analysis: Game script blowouts reduce passing volume for leading team WRs.
limitations: Player-level data not in main games.csv; derived from secondary sources.

name: Red Zone Target Share Anytime TD
hypothesis: Players with >30% red zone target share have higher anytime TD probability than market implies, especially vs weak red zone defenses.
entry_rule: Bet Anytime TD YES when RZ target share >30% and opponent red zone D allows >60% TD.
price_rule: Anytime TD odds +100 to +250, model prob >=52%.
failure_analysis: TD variance high; goal-line RB vulture.
limitations: TD props high variance; small sample.

name: RB Carry Share & Goal Line Usage Over
hypothesis: RBs with >60% carry share and >50% goal-line carry share exceed rushing yards props, especially as home favorites.
entry_rule: Bet RB Over rush yards when carry share >60% and team is favorite <-3 and opponent rush D bottom 10.
failure_analysis: Negative game script for favorite RB if trailing.
limitations: RB injuries cause carry share volatility.

name: Game Script Pass Rate Over
hypothesis: Games with expected high pass rate (>60%) due to spread (trailing team must pass) generate more plays and higher totals than market expects.
entry_rule: Bet Over when projected avg pass rate >60% and total <=48.
failure_analysis: Run-heavy leading team can bleed clock even if trailing team passes.
limitations: Pass rate projection depends on spread accuracy.

name: Game Script Pace & Tempo Over
hypothesis: Fast pace teams (top 10 neutral pace) vs fast pace opponents create high play volume, beating totals, especially indoors.
entry_rule: Bet Over when avg pace rank <=10 and total <=49.5.
failure_analysis: Slowdown in 4Q when game decided.
limitations: Pace rank changes throughout season.

name: Live Win Probability Market Inefficiency
hypothesis: Live win probability models using score, time, possession, down/distance, timeouts provide edge vs retail live markets that overreact to recent plays.
entry_rule: Bet live YES/NO when model WP differs >=7 cents from market and time remaining >5 min Q4.
exit_rule: Live contract settlement at game end or hedge.
failure_analysis: Turnover variance in live markets high.
limitations: Requires real-time play-by-play; forward test only until live feed verified.

name: Live Momentum & Drive Efficiency Over
hypothesis: Teams with high drive success rate and explosive play rate in first half maintain momentum, making live Over valuable if market underreacts.
entry_rule: Bet live Over when first half pace > expected and live total is below projection by >=3 pts.
failure_analysis: Second half adjustments can slow scoring.
limitations: Live totals liquidity limited; forward test.

name: Team Total Efficiency Differential
hypothesis: Poisson team total projections vs market team totals reveal inefficiencies, especially when spread is mispriced.
entry_rule: Bet team total Over/Under when Poisson diff >=2.5 pts.
exit_rule: Final team score vs team total line.
failure_analysis: Team totals correlated with spread; error in spread propagates.
limitations: Team totals not in historical archive; forward test partially.

name: Red Zone Efficiency Spread Advantage
hypothesis: Red zone efficiency differential predicts scoring margin beyond overall EPA.
entry_rule: Bet spread when RZ efficiency diff >=12%.
failure_analysis: Small sample red zone efficiency regresses.
limitations: Early season RZ sample noisy.

name: Alternate Spread Value with Poisson (2nd Version)
hypothesis: Alt spreads offer convexity when Poisson tail probabilities differ from market alt pricing.
entry_rule: Bet alt spread when tail prob edge >=6% and odds >=+120.
failure_analysis: Alt spread variance high.
limitations: Forward test only.

name: Four-Day Rest Differential ATS
hypothesis: A team with at least four more rest days than its opponent may cover more often than the market price implies.
data_sources: Bundled nflverse games.csv snapshot (home_rest, away_rest, spread, score, recorded spread odds)
entry_rule: Regular season; absolute rest differential >=4 days; back the more-rested team.
price_rule: Use the recorded side-specific spread price; $100 flat stake during testing.
exit_rule: Settle from observed final margin plus the home-team spread handicap.
failure_analysis: Corrected home-spread settlement shows the 2023-2025 holdout ROI was -7.25% across 81 bets (39-41-1, 48.75%), failing the positive-ROI gate; the earlier +2.83% figure was inflated by an away-spread sign error (now fixed to home-spread convention).
limitations: Threshold was declared before holdout evaluation in strategy_lab.py; source rest values may contain defaults where unavailable. Holdout failed after spread-sign correction.

name: Divisional High-Total Under
hypothesis: Divisional familiarity may reduce scoring relative to high posted totals.
data_sources: Bundled nflverse games.csv snapshot (div_game, total_line, total, under_odds)
entry_rule: Regular-season divisional game with a recorded total of at least 47.0; test Under.
price_rule: Use the recorded Under price; $100 flat stake during testing.
exit_rule: Settle against the observed combined final score.
failure_analysis: The 2023-2025 holdout edge was small: 1.21% ROI across 74 bets.
limitations: Historical passage does not establish a durable edge; this strategy remains prospective paper trading only.

name: EPA Differential Spread Edge (2.7:1 Ratio)
hypothesis: EPA differential 0.10 EPA/play advantage ~ 2.7 point predicted margin; strongest ATS predictor per academic research.
entry_rule: Bet spread when EPA diff advantage >=0.12 EPA/play over past 6 starts.
failure_analysis: Early season EPA noisy.
limitations: Requires EPA data.

name: EPA Differential High Conviction (>=3.5 pts)
hypothesis: EPA diff >=0.15 EPA with 3.5 pt threshold filters noise and delivers +57% win rate.
entry_rule: EPA diff >=0.15, edge >=3.5 pts.
failure_analysis: Turnover variance.
limitations: Early season.

name: Home Underdog Academic (53.5% ATS 2002-2011)
hypothesis: Home underdogs historically 53.5% ATS 2002-2011 per Szalkowski & Nelson 2012; test if still profitable post-2015.
entry_rule: Bet home when spread_line >0 and 1.0 <= spread <=7.5.
failure_analysis: Effectiveness diminishing over time; market adjusted.
limitations: Academic research shows diminishing returns; need OOS test.

name: Negative Binomial Totals (Overdispersion)
hypothesis: Poisson assumes variance=mean but NFL scoring has overdispersion; negative binomial accounts for extra variance improving tail pricing.
entry_rule: Bet Over/Under when NB projected total diff >=3.0 pts.
failure_analysis: OT scoring.
limitations: Requires variance estimation.

name: Market Timing: Favorites Early, Dogs Late
hypothesis: Moneyline market overvalues home field in close games; away teams in predicted win prob 0.3-0.7 profitable; line movement continues direction of opening 24h; bet favorites early week, underdogs late week.
entry_rule: If line moves >=1 pt, bet side receiving points late week for underdog value.
failure_analysis: Line shop critical.
limitations: Requires timestamped prices.

name: First Half Spread Value (55% of Full)
hypothesis: 1H spread is ~55% of full game spread; when full game has >=3 pt edge, 1H spread offers value.
entry_rule: Bet 1H spread when full game edge >=3.0 pts.
failure_analysis: 2H adjustments not applicable to 1H but variance high.
limitations: Historical 1H archive not in free nflverse; forward test only.

name: Quarter Market Q1 Over Value
hypothesis: Q1 scoring is ~20% of full total but market underprices fast-start offenses in Q1.
entry_rule: Bet Q1 Over when full total >=45 and pace rank top 10.
failure_analysis: Slow starts.
limitations: Q markets not in free archive; forward test only.

name: Futures Win Total Over (Elo >1550)
hypothesis: Teams with Elo >1550 at season start have >58% chance to go Over win total of 10.5.
entry_rule: Bet Over 10.5 wins when Elo >1550 in Week 1.
failure_analysis: Injuries derail win totals.
limitations: Futures settlement at season end; long holding period.

name: WR Usage v2 with Route Participation 85%+
hypothesis: Adding route participation >85% filters to true WR1 with full route tree, not situational deep threats.
entry_rule: WR1 target >22% AND route >85% AND opponent YPA >7.5.
failure_analysis: Game script blowouts.
limitations: Player data not in main feed.

name: Live WP v2 with Down/Distance & Timeouts
hypothesis: Live WP model incorporating down/distance, timeouts, field position provides 7c+ edge vs retail that overreacts to recent plays.
entry_rule: Bet live YES/NO when model WP diff >=7c and time >5 min Q4.
failure_analysis: Turnover variance high live.
limitations: Requires sub-second PBP.
